desc.text:
<color=#ffd780>Elemental Burst</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Apply</color> <color=#ffffff>Cost Reduction</color> <color=#ffffffa6>to 3 random cards with</color> <color=#ffffff>Current Elemental Dice Cost</color> <color=#ffffffa6>greater than 0 in your Hand. Generate 3 stacks of</color> <color=#ffffff>Pale Hymn</color> <color=#ffffffa6>.</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Pale Hymn</color>
<color=#ffd780>Combat Status</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Your</color> <color=#ffffff>Lunar-Bloom</color> <color=#ffffffa6>reactions deal +1 DMG.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Usage(s): 3</color>

<color=#ffd780>Passive Skill</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>(Passive) During this game, when your opponent is affected by</color> <color=#ffffff>Bloom reaction(s)</color> <color=#ffffffa6>, the reaction will be converted to the</color> <color=#ffffff>Lunar-Bloom</color> <color=#ffffffa6>reaction.</color>
<color=#ffffff>When the opponent is affected by Lunar-Bloom reaction:</color> <color=#ffffffa6>Apply</color> <color=#ffffff>Cost Reduction</color> <color=#ffffffa6>to 1 random card in your Deck.</color>

<color=#ffffffa6>Applies Dendro and can trigger the following Elemental Reactions:</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>[</color> <color=#99ff88>Dendro</color> <color=#ffffffa6>+</color> <color=#80bfff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffffa6>] Bloom: DMG +1 for this instance, creates a [</color> <color=#ffffff>Dendro Core</color> <color=#ffffffa6>] that greants +2 DMG to the next instance of Pyro or Electro DMG</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>[</color> <color=#99ff88>Dendro</color> <color=#ffffffa6>+</color> <color=#ff9999>Pyro</color> <color=#ffffffa6>] Burning: DMG +1 for this instance, creates a [</color> <color=#ffffff>Burning Flame</color> <color=#ffffffa6>] that will deal 1 Pyro DMG at the end of the Round (Takes effect once, max 2 stacks)</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>[</color> <color=#99ff88>Dendro</color> <color=#ffffffa6>+</color> <color=#ffacff>Electro</color> <color=#ffffffa6>] Quicken: DMG +1 for this instance, creates a [</color> <color=#ffffff>Catalyzing Field</color> <color=#ffffffa6>] that grants +1 DMG to the next 2 instances of Dendro or Electro DMG</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>[</color> <color=#99ff88>Dendro</color> <color=#ffffffa6>+</color> <color=#80bfff>Hydro</color> <color=#ffffffa6>] Lunar Bloom: Deal +1 DMG for this instance, and apply [</color> <color=#ffffff>Cost Reduction</color> <color=#ffffffa6>] to a random card in your Hand</color>

<color=#ece5d8>Cost Reduction</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Every stack makes playing this card cost 1 fewer Elemental Die. (Can stack, no stack limit)</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Current Elemental Dice Cost</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>If a</color> <color=#ffffff>Cost Increase</color> <color=#ffffffa6>or</color> <color=#ffffff>Cost Reduction</color> <color=#ffffffa6>is attached to an Action Card, its current Elemental Dice cost will be adjusted accordingly. (Effects that reduce the Elemental Dice cost when playing the card do not affect this cost.)</color>
<color=#ece5d8>Lunar-Bloom</color>
<color=#ffffffa6>Deal +1 DMG for this instance, and apply [</color> <color=#ffffff>Cost Reduction</color> <color=#ffffffa6>] to a random card in your Hand.</color>

customize.desc: Currency verified and used by the Genius Invokation TCG Society. Can be used to purchase various items related to Genius Invokation TCG. It is said that these coins were initially named as such in the hopes that they would bring those carrying them luck. However, perhaps it is those who are sufficiently lucky who are able to possess them...
